champs.nomAide: This is how the notebook will greet you.

inscription.note: The first pages are already filled in: 20 of Maryse's recipes are waiting for you.
inscription.verifieTexte: A confirmation link has been sent to {{email}}. Open it in this browser to reach your notebook.
inscription.consentement: By creating an account, you accept the <1>privacy policy</1>.

oubli.texte: Enter your address: you will receive a link to choose a new password.
oubli.envoyeTexte: If a notebook exists for {{email}}, an email is on its way. Open the link in this browser.

nouveau.succes: Password saved. Welcome to your notebook!
nouveau.lienInvalideTitre: This link is no longer valid
nouveau.lienInvalideTexte: The link may have expired or been opened in another browser. Ask for a new one.

erreurs.motDePasseCourt: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
erreurs.confirmation: The two passwords do not match.
erreurs.nonConfirme: Your address is not confirmed yet: open the link you received by email.
erreurs.dejaInscrit: A notebook already exists for this address. Sign in instead.
erreurs.motDePasseFaible: This password is too easy to guess. Choose a longer one.
erreurs.tropDeDemandes: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
erreurs.memeMotDePasse: Choose a password different from the old one.
erreurs.inconnue: The request did not go through. Check your connection and try again.
